guitar.notes: Fogerty used several guitars over CCR's career (Rickenbacker, Les Paul, Kustom K200); no single fully dominant model, medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: jangly clean Vox-ish edge with slight grit
tone.profile: jangly clean Vox-ish edge with slight grit
tone.summary: A bright, jangly signal chain using a light boost and the AC30 TB to capture the classic Vox sound, paired with a 2x12 cab for tight projection.

rig.name: Creedence Clearwater Revival - Looking out my back door - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Add subtle lift and brightness to enhance the jangle.
blocks.gap: A dedicated tone-shaping boost is used instead of a specific OD pedal, as the goal is light breakup, not overt drive.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and avoid heavy crunch.
Emulate the classic Vox AC30 sound for chime and brightness.
Provide a tight, focused projection suitable for jangly pop tones.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is chosen over the UK Vintage 4x12 to match the specified '2x12' clue and maintain tightness.

alternatives.reason: If a larger, more open sound was desired.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the high-end chime and cut unnecessary low frequencies.
No wah needed; focus on pure jangle.
Add subtle width and vintage movement without sounding lush.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add depth, but kept low to avoid the 'lush modulation' avoidance rule.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic echo for pop feel.
Provide a natural, non-overpowering vintage room ambience.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the vintage 60s pop feel and jangle.

proposals.reason: Enhance chime and vintage 60s pop feel beyond the US model.
